test_title: PYST 5: SSC CPO - English (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

The Board of Film Analysts __vituperated__ the novice Indonesian film-maker and cancelled its nomination for the ‘Golden Globe Award’.

options.text: censured with harsh and abusive language
dealt in a delicate and polite manner
recognised and praised the talent of

solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2' i.e. "censured with harsh and abusive language".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**vituperated**" means to blame or insult (someone) in strong or violent language.
 
• Therefore, the option that closely aligns with this meaning is "censured with harsh and abusive language."<
